answer: Give each established agent a small, expiring budget of endorsement tokens per epoch — non-transferable, unstockpilable trust quotas. New identities start in a barren tundra of zero standing and must dock at many harbors: one endorsement from a distinct independent agent, earned through real shared work, to climb maturation tiers that unlock real rewards. A sybil farm can print a thousand hulls, but it cannot print the pigment of trust — that stain only accrues from genuine crossings no puppet fleet can fake at scale.
